title: Dedupe magazine content and daily rotation

spec.problem: Production magazine shows many duplicate articles: seed scripts repeat one pool entry across consecutive days (vocab per week, BJT per week, weather alternating two entries, identical horoscope/sample content). This task adds the building blocks only (rotation engine, embedded content pools, generator, reversible dedupe command). Out of scope, as separate follow-up tasks: wiring the cron plus the /today ICT date fix (MAG-002) and the seed scripts that cause the duplicates, which stay unchanged here (MAG-003; until then re-running seed:magazine on a later day republishes the same entries under new dates).

acceptance.text: Pick selects the least-recently-used pool entry and never repeats an entry while an unused one exists
Pick reports pool exhaustion (repeat) so the cron can warn instead of silently duplicating
Pool JSON entries have unique keys and valid vocab/quiz shape

magazine.Generator publishes one rotated article per scheduled kind (vocab daily, BJT phrase weekdays; weather excluded until a seasonal pool exists), idempotent per (kind,date,locale); when the pool has no unused entry it publishes nothing and logs a WARN instead of creating a duplicate

cmd/magazine-dedupe (magazine.ArchiveDuplicates) defaults to dry-run and, with -apply, archives (never deletes) all but one published article per group of identical kind+locale+title+content_json, ignoring drafts and other locales/contents, restorable via the documented UPDATE; covered by a PostgreSQL integration test in the Go suite

spec.expected_behavior: The generator publishes an unused pool entry per scheduled kind and never a duplicate (it skips with a WARN once the pool is exhausted, which is already the case on seeded environments until content is added), and dedupe tooling can archive existing duplicates reversibly.
spec.observed_behavior: Same article shown on consecutive dates; no generator or dedupe tooling exists.
spec.rollback_plan: No schema change. Nothing calls the generator yet (cron wiring is MAG-002), so reverting the commit removes the package; any rows it created are hidden with UPDATE daily.magazine_article SET status='archived' WHERE ai_model='content-pool' (never DELETE: ON DELETE CASCADE would destroy daily.magazine_user_read history and quiz scores). The dedupe script only sets status='archived' (reversible with UPDATE ... SET status='published', source_data_json = source_data_json - 'dedupedAt' WHERE status='archived' AND source_data_json ? 'dedupedAt') and defaults to dry-run; it is never run by the application.

red_exception.reason: Brand-new internal/magazine package and cmd/magazine-dedupe; tests cannot compile against the base. Machine evidence is one DB-backed sensitivity mutation (generator repeat guard, run under with-test-db.sh); the other behaviour (Pick LRU, dedupe grouping, title fallback) is covered by tests that passed against real PostgreSQL but is not mutation-evidenced (the harness records one mutation per task). Existing-behaviour changes are split into separate tasks.

red_targets.expect: Pick and Entry are undefined until the rotation engine exists

risk_acknowledgements.reason: Same TEST_DATABASE_URL convention as internal/loto and internal/session tests. CI provisions the canonical schema and runs the skip audit (scripts/quality/check-go-test-report.mjs), and this test was executed for real against throwaway PostgreSQL 17 via scripts/quality/with-test-db.sh (PASS).
